title: 100-point Multi-Persona Stage 4A Architecture Red-Team Rubric (scored by architecture-critic; validated by 04/scripts/validate_architecture_scorecard.py)
scoringRules: Operate strictly in Critique-First, Sycophancy-Free mode: lead with failure modes, broken invariants, and attack surfaces rather than praise.

Score every criterion 0..maxPoints. Any criterion awarded > 0 MUST quote verbatim evidence (>= 25 chars, >= 5 words) from design/solution_design.md, design/architecture_design.md, design/*_architecture.md, or design/data_migration_and_cutover.md.
Criteria with 'appliesTo' not containing the project's inputScenario are not applicable: award maxPoints and set evidence to 'N/A — not applicable to greenfield requirements specifications'.
Any blocking criterion scored 0 forces verdict FAIL regardless of totalScore.
Verdict is PASS iff totalScore >= 90 and zero blocking criteria scored 0.

dimensions.title: Zero-Trust Security, BOLA Prevention & Zero-Leak Boundary
Multi-Zone Resilience, Access Paths & Coexistence Latency
Cloud-Neutral Operability, SLOs & FinOps TCO Sizing

criteria.title: 3NF relational normalization, primary/foreign keys & snake_case purity
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Every entity in design/solution_design.md has a primary key, explicit foreign-key relationships, snake_case naming, zero repeating groups, and zero legacy table/form identifier carry-over.

criteria.title: Atomic state-transition guards & optimistic/transactional race prevention
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Transition endpoints enforce (fromState, trigger, actorRole) atomically inside a database transaction or conditional UPDATE (WHERE current_state = expected_state) so concurrent requests cannot double-approve or skip states.

criteria.title: Legacy-to-3NF entity mapping & isolated Strangler coexistence boundary
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Maps every legacy store/object to normalized 3NF tables in design/solution_design.md §1.1 and isolates any phased-wave CDC/ACL bridge under deploy/coexistence/ with reconciliation checksums in design/data_migration_and_cutover.md.

criteria.title: Object-level authorization (BOLA/IDOR) & server-side RBAC enforcement
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Every OpenAPI mutation and entity-read path enforces server-side RBAC and tenant/owner scoping so an external actor cannot read or mutate another actor's record by guessing an ID.

criteria.title: Zero-Leak ViewModel/DTO boundary & PII masking at serialization
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Defines an explicit DTO/ViewModel serialization layer that strips internal surrogate keys/audit columns, masks sensitive identifiers per Spec Pillar 2, and maps UPPER_SNAKE enum codes to human display labels.

criteria.title: Keyless workload identity, STRICT mTLS & AI Trust Layer guardrails
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Eliminates static secrets via OIDC Workload Identity and KMS/Secrets Manager, enforces STRICT service-mesh mTLS, and applies PII redaction + grounded citations before any AI prompt invocation.

criteria.title: Regional/zonal blast-radius isolation, stateless compute & DB HA failover
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Web and API tiers are 100% stateless across multi-zone/multi-region Kubernetes pipelines with synchronous HA database standby failover, PgBouncer connection pooling, and PITR backups.

criteria.title: Indexed query access paths, N+1 avoidance & coexistence chatty-latency budget
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Declares B-Tree indexes on foreign keys and workflow status/filter columns, avoids per-row N+1 RPC loops, and budgets for >100 ms cross-boundary latency via async CDC/caching when coexisting with on-prem stores.

criteria.title: Cloud-agnostic KRM portability, OPA policy guardrails & GitOps waves
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Targets rootless OCI containers, portable KRM base + overlays across declared targetEnvironments, OPA admission constraints, and declarative GitOps wave promotion.

criteria.title: FinOps capacity sizing, autoscaling bounds & Spec-derived SLO burn-rate alerts
criteria.whatGoodLooksLike: Documents compute/database right-sizing, HPA min/max bounds, shared-network cost efficiency, TCO drivers, and OpenTelemetry SLIs/SLOs tied to workflow latency and availability.
